tinta.note: Page ground. Deliberately warm; pure #000 is out of the system.

tinta-2.note: One-step-lifted plate: footer, closing block, form panel, mobile panel, .seccion--placa.

hueso.note: The paper. Headlines, highlight box, primary button, the one bone band per page, selection and focus ring. 16.3:1 on ink.

hueso-3.note: Secondary prose, labels, row descriptions, rhombus borders. 5.96:1 on ink — set at this value to clear WCAG AA.

hueso-4.note: Quietest legible tier: timestamps, placeholders, footer legal, the button print offset. 4.92:1 on ink — the contrast floor.

linea.note: Every hairline divider, section top-border and row border.

linea-2.note: Input and menu-button borders — one step brighter, only where a control must read as touchable.

tenue.note: The dimmed clause inside the bone declaration band. 4.84:1 on bone, used at display size only.

error.note: Invalid input border only. Paired with #E0A79C for status text on a #4A2A26 border.

display.purpose: The black-weight clause of a page H1. Always paired with display-ligera in the same headline.

display-ligera.purpose: The light-weight setup clause of the same H1. The contrast is weight, never family.

headline.purpose: Section H2 and the closing block's call.

title.purpose: Row titles: layers, service modules, article entries.

entrada.purpose: Light-weight lead sentence opening a column, capped at 32ch.

declaracion.purpose: Centered light statement on the one bone band per page, capped at 20ch.

body.purpose: Long-form prose and article text, capped at 68ch.

body-chico.purpose: Row descriptions, form fields, footer links.

label.purpose: The single uppercase section-label voice at 0.24em. Used sparingly, never as a per-section eyebrow.

label-accion.purpose: Uppercase micro-type at 0.18em for buttons, links and nav.

shadows.name: print-offset
shadows.purpose: Primary button at rest. Zero blur — a second impression of the plate, not a light source.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: All state transitions (0.2s–0.5s): hover, nav hide/show, border and color shifts.

motion.name: grabar-ease
motion.purpose: The single authored engraving moment on the hero.

motion.name: grabar
motion.value: @keyframes grabar { from { clip-path: inset(0 100% 0 0); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 0 0); } }
motion.purpose: Left-to-right wipe: the headline is engraved onto the plate. Also drives the layer strip stagger.

motion.name: abrir-ojo
motion.value: @keyframes abrir-ojo { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.86); } to { opacity: 0.96; transform: scale(1); } }
motion.purpose: The hero eye opening at 0.34s delay.

motion.name: escribir-rombo
motion.value: @keyframes escribir-rombo { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(45deg) scale(0.7); } to { transform: rotate(45deg) scale(1); } }
motion.purpose: Each nested rhombus frame drawn in sequence at 0.42 / 0.54 / 0.66s.

motion.name: capa-stagger
motion.purpose: The four layers enter as a sequence after the hero, not as a scroll reveal.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Motion is fully disabled; scroll-behavior returns to auto.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sticky column released; 4-up layer strip becomes 2-up; fixed two-column grids flatten.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Nav links and CTA swap to the hamburger panel; service and article rows collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Single column throughout; --sec drops to a flat 64px; buttons go full width.

properties.--trazo: stroke color, default var(--hueso); set to var(--tinta) to invert the field on bone ground

burinField.invariant: A material layer, never a grid cell. An explicit specificity guard re-asserts position:absolute under .renglon, .nota, .cierre, .forma, .pie, .declara, .capa, .portada, .seccion and .seccion--placa. Any new burin-hosting container must be added to that guard.

narrative.overview:
The system is an engraved plate, not a page of components. Its material is the line field: repeating parallel strokes at a declared angle, pitch, and weight, laid behind whole sections the way a burin lays hatching behind a figure. Density is the only emphasis device the material has — a section is louder because its hatching is tighter, not because a box was drawn around it. The mark the whole world derives from is the brand's own isotipo, an eye inside a rhombus, and the rhombus recurs as the structural module at every scale: the 5px nav marker, the 6px list bullet, the 7px layer marker, and the three nested frames around the hero eye.

Density is high and the surface is nearly all ink. Warm printing black (#0B0A09, never pure black) is the ground for fifteen of sixteen page-regions; bone (#F1EADC) appears as paper only where the system deliberately flips — one declaration band per page, the bone highlight box inside a headline, and the primary button. Structure is drawn with hairlines and grid borders, never with fills, shadows, or corner radii. There are no cards: a service, a layer, a module, and an article all render as a full-bleed table row under a shared rule.

Confirmed rejections, all held by the shipped code: no serif and no monospace (one variable family, Archivo, carries every role), no photographic or illustrative imagery, no icon set, no card containers, and no per-section eyebrow. Typographic contrast is achieved by weight (300 against 800) inside a single headline, taken from the brand's real Instagram feed, not by mixing families.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Archivo variable, 100–900), self-hosted, contrast by weight alone
Warm ink ground everywhere; bone is the exception and reads as paper
Line fields (.buril) as material, driven by custom properties, never as content
Rhombus as the only recurring ornament, at four sizes
Zero corner radius, zero blur shadows, one hard offset shadow on the primary button
Rows and rules instead of cards; hover reveals hatching, not elevation
One authored motion moment on load; nothing animates on scroll

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: The ground is #0B0A09 and it is never #000. Every neutral in the system carries the same warm cast; a cool gray anywhere reads as foreign material.

rules.name: The One Plate Rule
rules.body: Exactly one region per page inverts to bone ground — the declaration band. Everything else is ink ground. A second bone panel destroys the contrast that makes the first one land.

rules.name: The Bone Floor Rule
rules.body: No text color below #857E72 (4.92:1) is used on ink. #948C80 and #857E72 were set at these exact values to clear WCAG AA; darkening them for atmosphere is not available.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Headline Rule
rules.body: Weight contrast happens inside one headline, never between two typefaces. Light (300) sets the setup clause, black (800) sets the claim, and exactly one word wears the bone box.

rules.name: The Bone Box Rule
rules.body: The highlight box (.alta) is a marker, not a highlighter. One word per headline, box-decoration-break: clone so it survives wrapping, and never applied to body copy.

rules.name: The One Label Voice Rule
rules.body: There is a single uppercase micro-type register in the site, and it does not appear above every section. A label earns its place by naming a column or a step, not by decorating a heading.

rules.name: The 68ch Rule
rules.body: Paragraphs are capped at 68ch globally (60–64ch inside rows, 700px inside articles). Full-width prose is not a layout option.

rules.name: The No-Blur Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system has zero blur radius. A soft drop shadow anywhere is out of material.

rules.name: The Density-Is-Emphasis Rule
rules.body: To make a region read as forward, raise its hatching --tono (0 → 0.10–0.17 on hover); never add a shadow, a border glow, or a lighter fill.

dos: Do build new content structures as full-bleed rows on a .plancha — a shared top rule, per-row bottom borders, baseline-aligned columns — rather than as cards.
Do give a new region depth by hosting a .buril field and tuning --ang, --paso, and --tono, and mask it so the hatching opens or closes across the region.
Do add any new burin-hosting container to the position: absolute specificity guard in the same commit that introduces it.
Do flip --trazo: var(--tinta) whenever a region takes bone ground, so the material inverts with the plate instead of disappearing.
Do compose H1s as a mixed-weight sentence: 300 setup, 800 claim, exactly one word in the bone box.
Do use the rhombus for any marker, bullet, or indicator that would otherwise want an icon — including form control affordances.
Do keep text at or above #857E72 on ink, and keep prose capped at 68ch.
Do author every string in sitio/build.py; the emitted index.html files are regenerated and hand edits are lost.
donts: Don't add a second typeface. Contrast is weight (300 vs 800) and tracking, inside one family.
Don't introduce corner radius. Every surface in the system is hard-cornered.
Don't use a blurred shadow. The only shadow is the button's zero-blur print offset.
Don't put a second bone-ground band on a page; the declaration band is the one plate.
Don't let a .buril become a grid or flex child — it is a material layer, and a captured field will reflow the layout it was meant to sit behind.
Don't add photographic or illustrative imagery, or an icon set. The isotipo mask and the rhombus are the only figures.
Don't put an uppercase eyebrow above every section; the label register is one voice used sparingly.
Don't attach scroll-triggered reveals. Motion is the single load-time engraving of the hero plus the layer stagger, and it yields to prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't ship #000 or a cool gray. Both ink and bone neutrals are warm.
